verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Svelte as a compiler that produces DOM-updating JavaScript. It also covers standalone SvelteKit app scaffolding and a Vite build that outputs files to a dist directory. Nothing documents mounting components into elements of an existing server-rendered page, or incremental adoption without a rewrite. A community note about prerendering a component to an HTML string is server-side rendering, not embedding interactive components into an existing page, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop the framework into an existing server-rendered HTML page and render interactive components without rewriting the whole page
